title: ㅋㅋㅋ = LOL… but ONE ㅋ = 'k.' 🥶 #learnkorean
caption:
ㅋ is the Korean 'k' sound (keu). Type it again and again and it turns into a laugh:

ㅋㅋ = haha
ㅋㅋㅋ = LOL
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ = LMAO
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ… = I'm dead

But just ONE ㅋ reads cold — like texting "k." to a friend. Send at least two!

SYNK LAB
#learnkorean #studykorean #koreanlanguage #koreanslang
pinnedComment: How many ㅋ do you usually send? Show me 👇
alt: A needle-felted cafe counter with a big felt phone and the coral felt mascot. Title: Korean friends laugh in ㅋ… but how many? The friend's reply pours out of the phone as cream felt ㅋ letters. One big ㅋ lands on the counter: = a 'k' sound (keu), type it again and again = a laugh. Chat bubbles count up: ㅋㅋ = haha, ㅋㅋㅋ = LOL, ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ = LMAO, a long row = I'm DEAD, while the letters pile up and the mascot laughs. The camera dives into the phone: the mascot asks "Want another joke?" and the friend answers with just one ㅋ. Just ONE ㅋ…? A wave of cold spreads from the phone and the whole cafe freezes; the mascot is stuck in a block of ice. ㅋ = 'k.' = cold. The ice cracks, then the friend sends ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ jk (just kidding), the ice shatters and the mascot laughs again.
